newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: IBCA upgrades Absa domestic longterm rating.
newsitem.headline: IBCA upgrades Absa domestic longterm rating.

text.p: International rating agency IBCA on Thursday upgraded the domestic long-term rating of Amalgamated Banks of South Africa Ltd (Absa) to AA from AA-.
IBCA reaffirmed Absa's international (individual B/C and legal 2T ratings.
Absa's domestic short-term A1+ rating was unchanged.

IBCA said Absa's domestic short and long-term ratings were now the highest assigned to a South African bank along with those accorded to the other three major banks in South Africa, Standard Bank Investment Bank Corp Ltd, First National Bank Holdings Ltd and Nedcor Ltd.
In domestic terms, Absa had the highest capacity for timely repayment in th short-term and a very low expectation of investment risk in the long-term.
The international individual rating of B/C indicated a bank whose performance was below its peers, but improving, IBCA said.
